rule: An environment failure is classified before any scientific interpretation; a matching signature is ENVIRONMENT, never evidence about the model. Failures whose text matches a `match` regex are labelled by tests/conftest.py (jomission.harness.envfail).

failures.signature: ModuleNotFoundError for a module present in this checkout, or behaviour of older code outside pytest
failures.cause: _editable_impl_jomission.pth pointed at the stale clone E:/jomission; pytest pythonpath=['.'] masks it
failures.repair: python -m pip install --no-deps -e E:/repos/jomission (default isolated build)

failures.signature: AttributeError inside hatchling during pip install --no-build-isolation
failures.cause: local hatchling incompatible with the build backend requirement

failures.signature: PermissionError / WinError 32 on TemporaryDirectory cleanup with an unclosed NpzFile (no mmap involved)
failures.cause: the tests' own np.load of an npz keeps the zip handle open at directory removal (Windows forbids deleting open files)
failures.repair: close the NpzFile before cleanup (TODO HD-WIN-FILELOCK, DONE: close() added in both tests)

failures.signature: process killed / MemoryError during V2.1-family batteries
failures.cause: ~32 GB RSS per battery process (4 x 5 s chunks, 400 neurons, dt 0.1 ms recordings)
failures.repair: run batteries serially, one process at a time

failures.signature: gh / git https authentication failure inside the agent sandbox
failures.cause: sandbox cannot read the Windows keyring
failures.repair: git push git@github.com:HNXJ/jomission.git <ref>:refs/heads/<branch>; gh operations run in the user's terminal
failures.match: could not read Username for 'https://github.com'|gh auth login

failures.signature: git status shows modified results/v21*_*.json after a test run
failures.cause: tier-3 battery and verdict tests write their result files
failures.repair: git checkout -- <path> for sealed paths; never commit a rewrite of a sealed artifact

failures.signature: command hangs indefinitely with no output
failures.cause: redirect to a path built from an unset shell variable left `cat >` waiting on stdin
failures.repair: write files with the editor tool, not heredoc redirects to variables
